description: The hosted Claim Protocol status payload for one issue, read live from the claim API: who holds it, until when, who is queued, and whether the repo honors the protocol. For agents that want the 60-second-fresh answer instead of the 15-minute static one. Read only; no token needed.

api_base.description: Override the hosted claim API base URL.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

name: api_status
